epics.name: Platform decision & mobile web baseline
epics.goal: PWA-first with a gated native shell; the head, standalone-mode rules, keyboard and touch behaviour every phone page inherits.

epics.name: Share to Kiwiply (capture on the phone)
epics.goal: A job link shared from any phone app becomes a saved application with a JD snapshot in two taps; Android via Web Share Target, iOS via paste/Shortcut until a native share extension.

epics.name: Send to laptop (cross-device apply)
epics.goal: Queue a job on the phone, fill it on the laptop: hand-off state on the application, a 'From your phone' list in the extension drawer, nudges, and QR pairing for the first install.

epics.name: Apply on the phone (honest assist)
epics.goal: When there is no extension: a one-tap 'My answers' copy sheet, resume PDF into the ATS file picker, the drawer on Firefox for Android as an experiment, Safari iOS extension only inside the shell.

epics.name: Mobile push & badges
epics.goal: The mobile delivery rules on top of U7/U17: iOS install gate, app-icon badges, notification actions, subscription liveness, per-platform etiquette caps.

epics.name: Offline & flaky networks
epics.goal: One network-aware fetch layer, low-data mode, read snapshots for Saved/Applications/queue and the share outbox — the only queued write in the product.

epics.name: Native shell (gated)
epics.goal: A Capacitor/TWA wrapper around the same web app, built only when the §4 gate in platform-decision.md passes: iOS Share Extension, native push, biometrics, store listings.

epics.name: Store payment compliance
epics.goal: Stripe stays the only truth: the PWA sells as the web does; a shell never uses IAP, links out where lawful (US) and is status-only elsewhere, via one purchaseSurface resolver.

epics.name: Mobile QA, devices & analytics
epics.goal: Playwright mobile projects, a real-device smoke, the mobile event taxonomy and the dashboards that decide the native-shell gate.

stories.title: Platform decision adopted: PWA-first, native shell gated on metrics
stories.story: As the product owner I want the PWA-vs-native decision recorded with a measurable gate so that no session re-litigates it and the shell is built only when iOS demand is proven.
stories.genz: They expect an app icon and the share sheet; we give them the icon now and promise the share sheet only where we can deliver it.
ac: docs/design/mob/platform-decision.md §0 decisions + §4 gate thresholds are referenced from ROADMAP.md (one paragraph) and PROGRESS.md 'Locked decisions'
The six gate metrics exist as named queries in the mobile event taxonomy (N8.3) so the N6.1 review can be run from the admin analytics page
web/README or web/CLAUDE.md states: no static export, no second client, shell = wrapper only
tests: Doc-sync test (vitest): the metric names listed in platform-decision.md §4 exist in web/src/lib/events.ts (after N8.3)

stories.story: As a phone user I want Kiwiply to respect my notch, status bar and dark mode so that the installed app looks native.
stories.genz: Dark mode and edge-to-edge are table stakes; a white status bar over a dark app reads as broken.

web/public/icons/{192,512,maskable-512,apple-touch-icon,badge-96}.png generated from brand/ (brand/README.md lists them as served copies)
globals.css defines --safe-top/right/bottom/left from env(safe-area-inset-*); AppShell header and the bottom tab bar (U0.1) consume them
All text inputs render ≥16px font on phones (no iOS focus zoom); buttons set touch-action: manipulation

stories.title: Standalone-mode rules: displayMode/platform helpers, external links, OAuth/Stripe round-trips, history-backed sheets, cold/warm deep links
stories.story: As an installed-app user I want links, sign-in, checkout and the back gesture to behave like an app so that I am never stranded in a chrome-less Safari sheet or kicked out of the app.
stories.genz: JobRight's top store complaint is deep links that forget the app is installed; we don't ship that bug.
ac: web/src/lib/pwa.ts exports displayMode() → browser|standalone|shell and platform() → ios|android|desktop; both attached as event props
External hrefs (postings, Reply in Gmail, Portal) open with rel=noopener in the system browser; same-origin navigation stays in scope
Google/Apple sign-in and Stripe Checkout/Portal return into the standalone window; no flow depends on sessionStorage set before the hop (state in URL/server)
@kiwiply/ui Sheet/Dialog gain `historyEntry` so Android back closes them; Escape unchanged on desktop
Deep links /applications?open=, /jobs?job=, /share?url= work cold and warm (notificationclick focuses the existing window)
tests: Playwright standalone project: external link opens a new context; back gesture (history.back) closes a sheet; cold deep link lands on the right route; login?next round-trip preserved
vitest: displayMode()/platform() UA matrix
evidence: web/src/app/connect/page.tsx (outside the (app) group — the pattern /share reuses)

stories.story: As a phone user I want lists to refresh with a pull and rows to offer actions on long-press so that the app feels native, not like a website.

stories.title: Web Share Target: share_target in the manifest + /share route + Save sheet (Android/Chromium)
stories.story: As a phone user I want to share a job link from LinkedIn, TikTok, Instagram or Chrome straight to Kiwiply so that it is saved in two taps without copying anything.
stories.genz: Discovery happens in TikTok/Instagram/LinkedIn on the phone; the share sheet is the universal 'send this somewhere' they already use.
stories.benchmark: G14 (P0, tagged N). Teal/Huntr need their extension or in-app browser to save; nobody is a share-sheet target. Huntr's App Store reviews: 'can't create entries from LinkedIn or Indeed'.
ac: manifest.webmanifest gains share_target {action:'/share', method:'GET', params:{title,text,url}}; Kiwiply appears in the Android share sheet once installed
web/src/app/share/page.tsx lives outside the (app) group; signed-out → /login?next=/share?… preserving params; URL taken from url or the first https:// in text (LinkedIn app shares the link in text)

Save sheet shows the resolved card (title, company, location, ATS, posted) with confidence-based editable fields; Save → toast with 8 s Undo; 'Save & send to laptop' also queues (N2.1 when present, else hidden)
history.replaceState so Back from the sheet returns to Saved, not to /share
Share payload validated: https only, ≤2 KB url, ≤1 KB title/text, HTML stripped; nothing is stored until Save is tapped
tests: Playwright Pixel project: GET /share?url=… signed-in → sheet → row appears in Saved; signed-out → login → sheet; invalid URL → error state
vitest: URL extraction from url/text; payload validation

stories.title: POST /api/jobs/resolve — URL normaliser + honest metadata (public ATS APIs, OG/JSON-LD, walled hosts never fetched) + JD snapshot
stories.story: As the share flow I want one endpoint that turns a shared URL into a job card with the description captured so that saves are rich without scraping anything.
stories.genz: They share links without titles; the card has to fill itself.
stories.benchmark: G4 (JD snapshot + resume link, P0) applied to phone saves; G14. Resolution uses the same public ATS board APIs the ingest already calls — no scraping (locked).
ac: Normalisation: strip utm_*/gh_src/lever-source/ref params, lowercase host, drop fragments/trailing slash; deterministic table-tested

ATS detection by host → Greenhouse/Lever/Ashby/Workable/SmartRecruiters via their public APIs; Workday and unknown public hosts → one GET (10 s, 1 MB, text/html, no cookies, fixed UA) parsing JSON-LD JobPosting then OpenGraph; walled hosts (linkedin.com, indeed.com, glassdoor.com, ziprecruiter.com) → no fetch, title/company from the shared text, needsConfirm

Response ResolvedJob {normalizedUrl, host, ats, postingId?, title?, company?, location?, remote?, salary?, descriptionText? (≤ 20 KB), confidence, needsConfirm[], existingApplicationId?}; matches an ingested job_posting by normalized URL when present
SSRF guard: https+443 only, DNS-resolved IP not private/link-local/loopback, no redirect to non-https, max 3 redirects; rate limit 20/min/user; never 5xx for a dead page (confidence LOW)
Feature flag share.resolve (A5.3 or a property until it exists)
tests: JobResolveServiceTest: normalisation table, per-ATS parsers on recorded fixtures (api/src/test/resources/resolve/*), walled-host no-fetch, SSRF refusals, redirect cap, size cap
JobResolveResourceIT: 422 invalid, 429 limit, existingApplicationId when a row matches
stories.tech: api/src/main/java/com/dossier/api/service/jobs/JobResolveService.java (reuse the ATS clients under service/jobs/*), web/rest/JobResolveResource.java, config property dossier.share.walled-hosts

stories.title: Share save → SAVED application with source_detail, normalized_url dedupe, description snapshot, undo; 'already in your tracker' state
stories.story: As a phone user I want a shared job to land in my tracker exactly once, with the description kept, so that the laptop and the resume tools can use it later.
stories.genz: No duplicates, no 'where did it go' — it is in Saved before they switch back to TikTok.
stories.benchmark: G4: the JD text and resume id live on the application row; Teal/Simplify store the JD at save time.
ac: Liquibase: application + source_detail, normalized_url (index), description_text (MEDIUMTEXT, ≤ 20 KB) — additive; ApplicationSyncResource upsert dedupes on normalized_url as well as externalJobId/jobUrl
POST /api/applications from /share writes status SAVED, source 'web', source_detail PHONE_SHARE|PHONE_PASTE|IOS_SHORTCUT, posting_id when resolved
Duplicate → sheet shows 'Already in your tracker (Applied 3 Oct)' with Open instead of Save
Undo within 8 s deletes the row (hard delete of a just-created SAVED row only)
Extension mirror sees the row on its next pull (sync signal 'changed' sent after save)
tests: ApplicationShareIT: dedupe by normalized_url, source_detail stored, description cap, undo path; extension pull includes the row (ApplicationSyncResource list)
Playwright: duplicate share shows the tracker state

stories.title: iOS capture path: 'Paste a link' on Saved, foreground paste chip, downloadable 'Save to Kiwiply' Shortcut + help page
stories.story: As an iPhone user I want a one-tap way to save a copied job link, and an optional share-sheet Shortcut, so that iOS is not a second-class phone until the native share extension exists.
stories.genz: iPhone share-sheet parity matters to the half of the audience on iOS; a Shortcut is a one-time setup they already know from TikTok download hacks.
stories.benchmark: G14 on iOS. No competitor PWA offers an iOS share path; Huntr/Teal rely on native apps for it.
ac: Saved header on iOS (platform()==='ios') shows [Paste a link]: reads the clipboard on tap (iOS paste bubble), extracts the first URL, opens the Save sheet (N1.1) with src=PHONE_PASTE; no URL → inline field
Foreground chip 'Save the link you copied?' appears on visibilitychange→visible only when the clipboard read is user-initiated (chip tap); never a silent read
web/public/shortcuts/Save-to-Kiwiply.shortcut + /help/save-on-iphone with 3 screenshots; the Shortcut opens https://kiwiply.com/share?url=…&src=ios-shortcut
Copy states plainly: 'until Apple lets web apps join the share sheet'

stories.title: Share outbox: offline saves queued in IndexedDB, replayed on focus/online/Background Sync
stories.story: As a phone user on a bad connection I want a shared job to be saved anyway so that I never lose a link I found on the train.
stories.genz: Spotty data on transit is where they scroll jobs.
ac: kiwiply-outbox IndexedDB store {id, kind: SAVE|QUEUE, payload, createdAt, attempts}; a failed POST from the Save sheet writes a row and shows 'Saved — will sync when you're online'
Replay on online event, on visibilitychange→visible, and via SW 'sync' tag kiwiply-outbox where Background Sync exists; server upsert makes replays idempotent
Max 5 attempts → row shows 'Couldn't sync — retry' in Saved; cleared on sign-out
This is the only queued write; every other offline write stays disabled (pwa-push.md §3)
tests: vitest: outbox add/replay/attempt logic with fake IDB (fake-indexeddb)
Playwright Pixel: route-block the API → share → outbox row → unblock → replayed, row in Saved
evidence: docs/design/user/pwa-push.md §3 (no queued writes — this story is the one exception)

stories.title: Share OUT: navigator.share for a job (to a friend, with referral) and for recap/outcome cards in social formats
stories.story: As a phone user I want to send a job or my weekly card to a friend with the system share sheet so that Kiwiply spreads the way the audience shares everything else.
stories.genz: Growth is a share sheet, not a 'copy link' button.
stories.benchmark: G35 (shareable outcome cards for TikTok/Instagram, U/M): this story is the phone delivery of U16.3's card — files via navigator.share, 1080×1920 and square, counts not company names by default.

Recap/outcome card (U16.3) 'Share image' → navigator.share({files:[png]}) in 1080×1920 and 1080×1080; no personal data by default, opt-in to company names
Events share_out {kind: job|card, platformHint}

stories.title: Hand-off model + API: handoff_state on application, queue/unqueue/opened endpoints, count on GET /api/profile/version, 14-day expiry job
stories.story: As a phone user I want to flag a saved job 'do this on my laptop' so that the laptop knows what to fill when I sit down.
stories.genz: Find it on the phone at lunch, fill it on the laptop at night — the loop nobody else closes.
stories.benchmark: No competitor has a phone→laptop queue (COMPETITIVE-LANDSCAPE.md feature matrix: hand-off row is ◐/○ for all 11). Glassdoor: mobile applicants complete 53 % fewer applications — the queue moves completion to the desktop.
ac: Liquibase (additive): application + handoff_state NONE|QUEUED|OPENED|DONE|EXPIRED, handoff_queued_at, handoff_opened_at, handoff_opened_on, handoff_note (≤140); index (user_id, handoff_state, handoff_queued_at)
POST /api/applications/{id}/handoff/queue {note?} · /unqueue · /opened {ua} (idempotent, owner-only); GET /api/applications/handoff?state=QUEUED → list for the extension/desktop web
GET /api/profile/version adds handoffQueued:int (ProfileVersionVM) — never 404, cheap COUNT with the index
Submit-detect (ApplicationSyncResource upsert to APPLIED) flips QUEUED/OPENED → DONE; nightly job expires QUEUED > 14 d → EXPIRED and emits STALE_NUDGE (digest-only) once
DSAR export includes the hand-off fields with the application
tests: ApplicationHandoffIT: queue→opened→done; unqueue; re-queue; expiry job; idempotency; foreign-user 404; handoffQueued on /api/profile/version
ProfileVersionVM serialisation test
stories.tech: api Liquibase 2026101xxxxx_application_handoff.xml, web/rest/ApplicationHandoffResource.java, service/ApplicationHandoffService.java, ProfileResource.java:58-73 + vm/ProfileVersionVM.java, ApplicationSyncResource.java

stories.story: As a phone user I want one tap to queue a job and a clear status of what happened on the laptop so that I trust the loop.

Row states: Waiting on your laptop [Un-queue] · Opened on <browser · device> at <time> · Applied ✓ · Expired (Still want it?)

stories.title: Laptop nudges: once-a-day desktop notification from the extension while the queue is non-empty + 'Tonight: 3 jobs ready' digest section via the engine
stories.story: As a user I want a gentle reminder on the laptop that my phone queue is waiting so that the jobs I found do not expire unread.
stories.genz: One nudge, on the right device, at the right time; never a push to the phone that started it.

Respects quiet hours (engine) and the user's channel matrix

stories.title: Notification actions: per-kind SW actions (See jobs / Mute this alert, Open / Add note, Prep) with a same-origin action endpoint

stories.title: Network-aware fetch layer: timeouts, idempotent retry with jitter, offline banner, low-data mode flag
stories.story: As a phone user on a weak signal I want pages to fail fast and say so instead of spinning forever so that I know whether to retry.
stories.genz: A spinner that never ends is a broken app; an honest 'you're offline' is fine.
ac: web/src/lib/net.ts wraps client fetches: 10 s GET / 30 s upload timeouts, one retry with jitter on network error/502/503 for GET and idempotent PUT; errors typed (Offline, Timeout, Http)
Offline banner in the app shell driven by online/offline events + a failed-probe fallback; dismisses on recovery
Low-data mode when navigator.connection.saveData or effectiveType ∈ {slow-2g, 2g}: <html data-saver>, Link prefetch off, next/image smaller sizes, no decorative art
Client errors from net.ts feed U19.5 monitoring when it exists
tests: vitest: timeout/retry matrix, error typing, low-data detection
Playwright Pixel: route abort → banner; restore → banner gone
evidence: web/src/lib/api.ts (server fetch helper; client fetches are ad hoc today)
